title: Consensus Protocol
key_points: XRP Ledger uses a unique consensus algorithm called the Unique Representation of Values (URV) based on a modified version of the Nemenyi-Vajda hash function.
The URV enables validators to reach agreement on transactions without revealing or exchanging private keys, maintaining security and privacy for users.
Validators are selected using a deterministic process that takes into account their reputation, uptime, and performance.
The consensus protocol is designed to be fast and efficient, with the ability to handle high transaction volumes and adapt to network conditions.
limitations: Limited explanation of the technical details behind the URV hash function and its properties.
Does not delve into the specific mathematical formulations or proof-of-work aspects of the protocol.
The scope is limited to a high-level overview of the consensus mechanism, lacking in-depth analysis.
asserts: The XRP Ledger utilizes a unique consensus protocol called the Unique Representation of Values (URV), which allows validators to reach agreement on transactions without revealing or exchanging private keys.
scope: Explains how the URV-based consensus protocol works within the context of the XRP Ledger, focusing on its design to maintain security and privacy while enabling efficient transaction processing.
